In addition, A-1 Affordable failed to produce any written change orders during the time that the work was being done to receive approval for the additional work.  The final bull was WAY more than discussed.

The final bill was also indecipherable (photo below).  When asked for a breakdown so we could figure out what happened, the sales representative claimed that he couldn't remember the pricing and instructed us to call their office. Being a trusting elderly woman that didn't think this could happen, she felt pressured and in turn just wrote out the check.

After allegedly trying to figure out what happened, an A-1 Affordable office staff member ALSO could not read the receipt that their own salesman provided. After repeatedly calling their office and making a visit for over a week to find out how we got billed so much money, an office staff member finally called back with a verbal explanation that didn't make any sense. Their lack of transparency was truly both shocking and disappointing.

We also requested an estimate to have our roof replaced by A-1 Affordable.  After pricing them out against the two qualified competitors, we realized that they were 40% higher in price. Once again, it was the sales representative giving pricing verbally, while he later stated that he forgot the pricing that he had just quoted during the conversation a short time earlier.

When researching A-1 Affordable we confirmed they do a lot of work for PSE&G. The quality of their work is good, but unfortunately it seems as though they charge private homeowners as though they are also utility companies. They are well established and have a more than impressive facility for a roofing company.  Even more impressive is their employee parking lot, filled with Porches and other very expensive luxury cars.

Of course a company is free to work at whatever profit margin that they choose.  However, being honest and upfront with their customers regarding pricing before they perform the work is something that any reputable company should always do.

Bottom line is that I would strongly recommend anybody considering A-1 Affordable to perform any work for them to get at least two other estimates and to require that everything be clearly stated in legible writing prior to starting the job to avoid having a similar experience to the one I have described.

I do hope this post motivates A-1 Affordable to become a more transparent company when dealing with the public, because there is no reason that any customer should feel the way that I described after working with any contractor.
